info.title: TrackPlay API
info.description: Send conversions and events to TrackPlay, and read them back. Authenticated with scoped tokens you mint in the dashboard.

post.description:
Credit a sale to the video that caused it. Send `session_code` from the player so the conversion joins the play that produced it. Without it, the sale is recorded but cannot be attributed to a viewer.

Requires a token with the `conversions:write` scope.

Server: `https://app.trackplay.io/api/v1`

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe key. The first response for a given key is cached for 24 hours and replayed on a repeat, with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` set. Send one on every call. A retried payment webhook without it will double count the sale.

sale.summary: A sale attributed to a viewer's session

attributed_to_split_test.description: True when the conversion was credited to a split-test arm.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or revoked token.

403.description: Token does not carry the `conversions:write` scope.

404.description: No video with that `video_code` exists in this workspace.

examples: Video not found in this workspace.

422.description: Validation failed.

429.description: Rate limited. The write limit is 60 requests per minute per token.

503.description: The conversion could not be written. Retry with the same `Idempotency-Key`.

post.description:
Record something the player never saw (a lead form, a quiz completion, an upsell) and land it on the viewer's session.

A custom event is not a conversion. `value` is reported on its own and never feeds revenue, ROAS, EPC, or RPV. Send money through [Record a conversion](/api-reference/conversions/create) instead.

Requires a token with the `events:write` scope. The legacy `tp_` workspace key is rejected here.

Server: `https://e.trackplay.io`

attributed.summary: Event tied to a known session

identity.summary: No session. Resolve the viewer by email

200.description: Recorded and attributed to a session.

202.description: Recorded, but no session matched. The event is kept in the Unattributed bucket. It is never dropped, and never guessed at. If you see this, the identifier you sent did not resolve to a viewer.

400.description:
`INVALID_PAYLOAD`: a field failed validation, or an unknown field was sent.

`INVALID_EVENT_NAME`: `event` contained no usable characters after normalization.

401.description:
`AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent.

`INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

422.description: `TOO_MANY_EVENT_NAMES`: this workspace has used its 100 distinct event names. Event names must be a small fixed set. Put the varying part in `properties`, not in the name.

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: 600 events per minute per workspace, or 120 per minute per IP.

500.description: `WRITE_FAILED`: the event could not be written. Retry with the same `event_id`. The retry will not double count.

503.description: `AUTH_UNAVAILABLE`: token verification is temporarily unavailable. This is never a rejection of your token. Retry shortly.

get.description:
The headline numbers for one video over a date range: plays, unique plays, completions, completion rate, average watch time, and bounces. This is the play-to-buyer story in one call.

The response carries `Cache-Control: private, max-age=60` and an `ETag`, and the summary is computed once and cached for 60 seconds. Conditional requests are not honoured yet: sending the `ETag` back as `If-None-Match` returns a full `200`, never a `304`.

Requires a token with the `analytics:read` scope.

Server: `https://app.trackplay.io/api/v1`

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: The video's numeric ID. It is the `video_id` returned in every analytics response.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the range, as an ISO date (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Defaults to 30 days ago.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the range, as an ISO date (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Defaults to today.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: Timezone the range is read in, as an IANA name (`America/New_York`). Defaults to `UTC`.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

404.description: No video with that ID exists in this workspace.

422.description: Validation failed. A date could not be parsed, or `to` fell before `from`.

429.description: Rate limited. Reads are capped at 600 requests per minute per token.

get.description:
The share of viewers still watching at each point through the video. Plot it to see the exact second your VSL loses people.

Each bucket carries `watch_pct` as a **fraction between 0 and 1**, not a percent. `0.5` means half of viewers reached that point. Multiply by 100 to render a percentage.

Requires a token with the `analytics:read` scope.

Server: `https://app.trackplay.io/api/v1`

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: The video's numeric ID.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the range, as an ISO date. Defaults to 30 days ago.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the range, as an ISO date. Defaults to today.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: Timezone the range is read in, as an IANA name. Defaults to `UTC`.

parameters.name: buckets
parameters.description: How many points to divide the video into. Defaults to 100. Capped at 200.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

404.description: No video with that ID exists in this workspace.

422.description: Validation failed. A date could not be parsed, `to` fell before `from`, or `buckets` was out of range.

429.description: Rate limited. Reads are capped at 600 requests per minute per token.

get.description:
The raw, auditable event stream for one video: every play, pause, ended, and conversion, one row at a time. No vanity metric sits on top of it.

This endpoint is paginated. Read `events.total` for the count, then walk the pages with `page` and `per_page`. `ip_hash` is always `null` in the API response.

Requires a token with the `analytics:read` scope.

Server: `https://app.trackplay.io/api/v1`

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: The video's numeric ID.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the range, as an ISO date. Defaults to 7 days ago.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the range, as an ISO date. Defaults to today.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: Timezone the range is read in, as an IANA name. Defaults to `UTC`.

parameters.name: event_type
parameters.description: Return only this event type, e.g. `play`, `pause`, `ended`, or `conversion`. Omit to return every type.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Which page to return. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Rows per page. Defaults to 100. Capped at 500.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

404.description: No video with that ID exists in this workspace.

422.description: Validation failed. A date could not be parsed, `to` fell before `from`, or `per_page` was out of range.

Sales credited to one video over a date range, grouped by conversion name, with a count and total revenue for each. This is the money the video earned, not the plays it counted.

Requires a token with the `analytics:read` scope.

Server: `https://app.trackplay.io/api/v1`

post.description:
Ask for a batch of analytics as a file. An export runs in the background, so this call returns straight away with an `export_id` and `status: pending`. Poll `GET /exports/{export}` until it is `ready`, then fetch the file from `download_url`.

One export can cover up to 50 videos.

Send an `Idempotency-Key` so a retried request returns the same export instead of starting a second one.

Requires a token with the `analytics:read` scope.

Server: `https://app.trackplay.io/api/v1`

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe key. The first response for a given key is cached for 24 hours and replayed on a repeat, with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` set.

events.summary: Export raw events for two videos as CSV

202.description: Accepted. The export is queued. Poll its status to get the download link.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

404.description: One or more of the `video_ids` do not exist in this workspace.

error.message: One or more video IDs not found.

422.description: Validation failed. Check `video_ids` holds 1 to 50 IDs, `to` is on or after `from`, and `format` and `type` are one of the allowed values.

429.description: Rate limited. Reads are capped at 600 requests per minute per token.

get.description:
Poll an export's status. While it runs, `status` is `pending`. When it finishes, `status` is `ready` and `download_url` carries the link to the file. Fetch the file from there.

An export expires after a while. A finished-then-expired export returns `404`.

Requires a token with the `analytics:read` scope.

Server: `https://app.trackplay.io/api/v1`

parameters.name: export
parameters.description: The `export_id` returned when you started the export, e.g. `tpex_9f2c1a7e4d3b4a11`.

200.description: The export's current status. Carries `download_url` once `status` is `ready`.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

404.description: No export with that ID, or it has expired.

429.description: Rate limited. Reads are capped at 600 requests per minute per token.

get.description:
Returns the ID, name, and public code of the workspace the token belongs to. Useful as a lightweight check that a token is valid and to learn the workspace's code before calling endpoints that need it.

Requires a token with the `videos:read` scope.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

429.description: Rate limited. 600 requests per minute per token.

get.description:
Lists the videos in this workspace, paginated, with optional sorting.

Requires a token with the `videos:read` scope.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Which column to sort by. Any other value is ignored and the list falls back to `id desc`.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

429.description: Rate limited. 600 requests per minute per token.

post.description:
Creates a new, empty video shell. The video has no playable media until you upload one with the resumable upload protocol or the single-shot upload endpoint.

Pass `copy_from` to clone every option-group setting (style, playback, autoplay, captions, chapters, CTA cards, and the rest) from an existing video in this workspace. Source media is never copied: the new video still needs its own upload.

Fires the `video.created` webhook.

Requires a token with the `videos:write` scope.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe key. The first response for a given key is cached for 24 hours and replayed on a repeat, with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` set.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

422.description: Validation failed.

429.description: Rate limited. 60 requests per minute per token.

get.description:
Reads one video by its numeric ID.

Requires a token with the `videos:read` scope.

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: The video's numeric ID.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

404.description: No video with that ID exists in this workspace.

429.description: Rate limited. 600 requests per minute per token.

patch.description:
Updates a video's title, folder, or tags. Every field is optional: send only what you want to change. This endpoint does not touch playback settings; use draft and deploy for those.

Requires a token with the `videos:write` scope.

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: The video's numeric ID.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe key. The first response for a given key is cached for 24 hours and replayed on a repeat, with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` set.

404.description: No video with that ID exists in this workspace.

422.description: Validation failed.

429.description: Rate limited. 60 requests per minute per token.

delete.description:
Deletes a video and any pending settings draft on it. This does not delete the video's past deploy versions or its analytics history. Fires the `video.deleted` webhook.

This cannot be undone through the API. There is no restore-a-deleted-video endpoint.

Requires a token with the `videos:write` scope.

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: The video's numeric ID.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe key. The first response for a given key is cached for 24 hours and replayed on a repeat, with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` set.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

404.description: No video with that ID exists in this workspace.

429.description: Rate limited. 60 requests per minute per token.

post.description:
Copies a video, including every option-group setting, under a new title (`<original title> (copy)`). The copy's HLS URLs and thumbnails are cleared: a duplicate needs its own upload, because media is never copied.

Requires a token with the `videos:write` scope.

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: The video's numeric ID.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe key. The first response for a given key is cached for 24 hours and replayed on a repeat, with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` set.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

404.description: No video with that ID exists in this workspace.

429.description: Rate limited. 60 requests per minute per token.

get.description:
Returns every option-group column on the video: style, playback, autoplay, captions, chapters, CTA cards, playlist, and the rest. This is the live, deployed settings, not a draft.

Requires a token with the `videos:read` scope.

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: The video's numeric ID.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

404.description: No video with that ID exists in this workspace.

429.description: Rate limited. 600 requests per minute per token.

get.description:
Returns the ready-to-paste embed HTML for this video, along with its timed events (chapters, CTA cards, and similar) in playback order.

Requires a token with the `videos:read` scope.

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: The video's numeric ID.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

404.description: No video with that ID exists in this workspace.

429.description: Rate limited. 600 requests per minute per token.

get.description:
Returns the shape the embed loader itself reads to size the player before the first frame paints: the workspace and video codes, and each orientation's dimensions and aspect ratio. `landscape` or `portrait` is `null` until an asset has been uploaded for that orientation.

Requires a token with the `videos:read` scope.

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: The video's numeric ID.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

404.description: No video with that ID exists in this workspace.

429.description: Rate limited. 600 requests per minute per token.

post.description:
Saves a partial or full settings payload without publishing it. The payload is merged recursively over whatever is already drafted, or over the live settings if there is no draft yet, so you only need to send the option groups you are changing.

The merged payload is validated with the same rules the dashboard's Customize screen enforces, so an invalid value in any option group fails the whole request. Nothing is published: the player a viewer sees is unchanged until you call deploy.

Requires a token with the `videos:write` scope.

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: The video's numeric ID.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe key. The first response for a given key is cached for 24 hours and replayed on a repeat, with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` set.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

404.description: No video with that ID exists in this workspace.

422.description: Validation failed on the merged settings payload.

429.description: Rate limited. 60 requests per minute per token.

post.description:
Publishes a partial or full settings payload and recompiles the player bundle. The payload is merged recursively over the current live settings, validated, saved, and any pending draft is cleared.

The player is compiled and pushed to both CDNs before anything is marked live: if the compile or the CDN push fails, the call fails with a 500 and the previous version keeps serving, so a viewer never sees a half-published player. On success this busts the AI-segment settings cache, snapshots a new version you can restore later, and fires the `video.settings.deployed` webhook.

Requires a token with the `videos:write` scope.

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: The video's numeric ID.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe key. The first response for a given key is cached for 24 hours and replayed on a repeat, with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` set.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

404.description: No video with that ID exists in this workspace.

422.description: Validation failed on the merged settings payload.

429.description: Rate limited. 60 requests per minute per token.

500.description: The player failed to compile, or the compiled bundle failed to reach the CDN. Nothing was marked live. Retry the deploy.

get.description:
Lists this video's deploy versions, newest first, 20 per page. Each entry is a full settings snapshot you can inspect or restore.

Requires a token with the `videos:write` scope, because a version's `settings_snapshot` can carry the same sensitive fields (Stripe price IDs, pixel IDs) a write token is already trusted with.

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: The video's numeric ID.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

404.description: No video with that ID exists in this workspace.

429.description: Rate limited. 60 requests per minute per token.

post.description:
Re-applies a past version's settings snapshot as the video's live settings, recompiles the player, and snapshots the restore itself as a new version. Restoring is not destructive to history: the version you restored from, and every version before it, are still there afterward.

Like deploy, the player is compiled and pushed to both CDNs before anything is marked live.

Requires a token with the `videos:write` scope.

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: The video's numeric ID.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The version ID to restore, from `GET /videos/{video}/deploys`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe key. The first response for a given key is cached for 24 hours and replayed on a repeat, with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` set.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

404.description: No video with that ID exists in this workspace, or no version with that ID exists on this video.

429.description: Rate limited. 60 requests per minute per token.

500.description: The player failed to compile, or the compiled bundle failed to reach the CDN. The video's settings were already overwritten with the restored snapshot at this point; retry the restore to reach a consistent compiled state.

post.description:
Starts a resumable upload session for one orientation of a video. Send the file in 20 MB chunks with `PATCH /uploads/{upload}`, then finish with `POST /uploads/{upload}/complete`. The session expires 24 hours after it is created; chunks sent after that return `404 UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND`.

For files under 100 MB, the single-shot upload endpoint is simpler and needs no session management.

Requires a token with the `videos:write` scope.

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: The video's numeric ID.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe key. The first response for a given key is cached for 24 hours and replayed on a repeat, with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` set.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

404.description: No video with that ID exists in this workspace.

422.description: Validation failed. Check `size` is between 1 and 10,737,418,240 bytes, and `mime_type` is one of the supported video types.

429.description: Rate limited. 60 requests per minute per token.

patch.description:
Sends one chunk of raw bytes for a resumable upload session. Send the `Upload-Offset` header set to the number of bytes already sent (0 for the first chunk), and the chunk itself as the raw request body with `Content-Type: application/offset+octet-stream`.

This call is idempotent at the current offset: resending the offset you already sent returns the session's current offset unchanged, without writing the chunk twice. Sending an offset ahead of what the session has recorded means a chunk was lost in transit; the call fails with a 409 so you can resend from the session's real offset instead of leaving a gap in the assembled file.

Requires a token with the `videos:write` scope.

parameters.name: upload
parameters.description: The `upload_id` from `POST /videos/{video}/upload/init`.

parameters.name: Upload-Offset
parameters.description: The number of bytes already sent for this upload, before this chunk.

200.description: The chunk was written, or this offset was already written and the chunk was not repeated.

400.description: `EMPTY_CHUNK`: the request body carried no bytes.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

404.description: `UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND`: no upload session with that ID, or it expired.

409.description: `OFFSET_MISMATCH`: the `Upload-Offset` header does not match the session's recorded offset. The response names the expected offset; resend from there.

429.description: Rate limited. 60 requests per minute per token.

delete.description:
Cancels a resumable upload session and deletes any chunks received so far. Returns `{"deleted": true}` even if the session had already expired or never existed: aborting a session that is not there is not an error.

Requires a token with the `videos:write` scope.

parameters.name: upload
parameters.description: The `upload_id` from `POST /videos/{video}/upload/init`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe key. The first response for a given key is cached for 24 hours and replayed on a repeat, with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` set.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

429.description: Rate limited. 60 requests per minute per token.

post.description:
Assembles every chunk received for this session in order and pushes the result to the video CDN. On success, the video's HLS URL and dimensions for that orientation are set and the session's temporary files are deleted. Fires the `video.uploaded` webhook.

Calling this before any chunks were sent fails with a 400. A CDN failure leaves the video unchanged and returns a 500: retry the complete call, the assembled chunks are only cleaned up after a successful push.

Requires a token with the `videos:write` scope.

parameters.name: upload
parameters.description: The `upload_id` from `POST /videos/{video}/upload/init`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe key. The first response for a given key is cached for 24 hours and replayed on a repeat, with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` set.

200.description: Upload finished. The video now carries the uploaded asset for the requested orientation.

400.description: `NO_CHUNKS`: no chunks were received for this session before calling complete.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

404.description: `UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND`: no upload session with that ID, or it expired. `VIDEO_NOT_FOUND`: the video the session was started for no longer exists in this workspace.

429.description: Rate limited. 60 requests per minute per token.

500.description: `CDN_ERROR`: the assembled file failed to reach the CDN. Retry the complete call.

post.summary: Upload a video in one request
post.description:
Uploads a video file directly, for files up to 100 MB. Send `multipart/form-data` with the file in a `file` field. For larger files, use the resumable upload protocol (`POST /videos/{video}/upload/init` and following) instead: a single request that fails partway through a 100 MB body has to restart from zero, a resumable session does not.

On success, the video's HLS URL and dimensions for the requested orientation are set. Fires no webhook: `video.uploaded` only fires from the resumable protocol's complete step.

Requires a token with the `videos:write` scope.

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: The video's numeric ID.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe key. The first response for a given key is cached for 24 hours and replayed on a repeat, with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` set.

file.description: The video file. Up to 100 MB. Must be mp4, mov (quicktime/m4v), avi, or webm.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

404.description: No video with that ID exists in this workspace.

422.description: Validation failed. `file` is required, at most 100 MB, and must be one of the supported video MIME types.

429.description: Rate limited. 60 requests per minute per token.

500.description: `CDN_ERROR`: the file failed to reach the CDN. Retry the upload.

put.summary: Add or replace a caption track
put.description:
Adds a caption track for the given language, or replaces the existing track for that language if one is already saved. This only ever touches the one language in the path: every other track on the video is left alone. Recompiles the player so the new track is live immediately.

Requires a token with the `videos:write` scope.

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: The video's numeric ID.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: The language code for this track, e.g. `en` or `es`. Not validated against a fixed list: whatever you send is what viewers see as the track's key.

200.description: The video's full caption track list, including the track you wrote.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

404.description: No video with that ID exists in this workspace.

422.description: Validation failed.

429.description: Rate limited. 60 requests per minute per token.

put.description:
Replaces the video's entire chapter list. This is a full replace, not a merge: send every chapter you want to keep, including ones already saved, or they are removed. An empty `chapters` array turns chapters off. Recompiles the player.

Requires a token with the `videos:write` scope.

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: The video's numeric ID.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

404.description: No video with that ID exists in this workspace.

422.description: Validation failed.

429.description: Rate limited. 60 requests per minute per token.

post.description:
Replaces the video's entire AI-segment list: the labeled time ranges used for segment-based navigation and highlights. This is a full replace, not a merge. Busts the AI-segment settings cache on the events edge so the new segments are visible on the next load, without a full deploy.

Requires a token with the `videos:write` scope.

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: The video's numeric ID.

401.description: `AUTH_REQUIRED`: no token sent. `INVALID_TOKEN`: the token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

404.description: No video with that ID exists in this workspace.

422.description: Validation failed. Check every segment's `end_s` is greater than its `start_s`.

429.description: Rate limited. 60 requests per minute per token.

post.description:

Because the caller is unauthenticated, a page-claimed identity is written at the lowest rung of TrackPlay's confidence ladder. A verified lead-form submission or a server-to-server event carrying the same email outranks it and wins on conflict.

Send a raw `email` together with `video_code` and TrackPlay also tees a lead into the workspace's lead list for that video, in addition to writing the identity graph edge. Pre-hashed email alone does not: a hash cannot populate a human-readable lead record.

A call naming no identity signal cannot be resolved to anyone.

This is a fallback, not a replacement for a real integration postback. Every row it writes is stamped unverified: it is excluded from revenue, EPC, RPV, ROAS, and every other aggregate that only counts server-confirmed sales, and it never fires ad-platform pixels or CRM webhooks. If the same order later arrives through the integration's real postback, the two collapse into one row and the verified postback always wins, regardless of which arrived first.

The integration named in `integration` must have the browser conversion fallback turned on for this workspace, or the call is rejected. Turn it on in TrackPlay under that integration's settings.

events.description: Which events this subscription fires on. Every entry must be one of the supported event names.

secret.description: Used to HMAC-SHA256 sign deliveries in the `X-Trackplay-Signature` header. Generated for you if omitted, but a generated secret can never be read back, only rotated by deleting and recreating the subscription. Send your own if you need to know it ahead of time.

status_code.description: The HTTP status your endpoint returned for the test delivery.

WebhookTestFailureResponse.description: Returned with a 502 when the test delivery could not be sent at all (DNS failure, connection refused, timeout). A non-2xx response from your endpoint still counts as delivered: check `status_code` on the 200 response for that case.

key.description: The trigger key. Use this in `POST /zapier/subscribe` and `GET /zapier/triggers/{event}/sample`.

event.description: The underlying lifecycle event this trigger maps to one-to-one.

data.description: The event's payload. Shape depends on the trigger.

ZapierSampleResponse.description: A one-element array holding the sample envelope. Zapier's polling-trigger contract expects an array, even though there is only ever one sample.

target_url.description: The Zap's hook URL. TrackPlay POSTs a signed delivery here on every matching event.

id.description: Echo this back on `DELETE /zapier/subscribe/{id}` to unsubscribe.

event.description: The underlying lifecycle event name this subscription was created for.

video_code.description: The video this identity is associated with. Send it along with a raw `email` to also tee a lead into the workspace's lead list.

session_code.description: The tracker's session ID, if you have one.

device_id.description: The tracker's local device ID, if you have one.

email.description: A raw email address. Hashed on arrival to both SHA-256 and MD5, and never stored raw.

email_sha256.description: A pre-hashed email, lowercase hex, if you hash client-side instead of sending it raw.

phone.description: A raw phone number. Normalized to E.164 and hashed on arrival.

external_id.description: Your own customer ID, if you already have one for this viewer.

IdentifyRequest.description: At least one identity signal is required: `email`, `email_sha256`, `email_md5`, `phone`, `phone_sha256`, `phone_md5`, `external_id`, `session_code`, `device_id`, or `device_global_id`. A payload naming none of them is rejected, because it would mint an identity that nothing can ever resolve back to. Any field not listed here is rejected outright: the schema is closed.

profile_id.description: The resolved or newly minted profile ID. `null` only in the failure paths, never on a 200.

integration.description: Which cart integration this fallback backs, e.g. `clickbank`. Required. The integration must have the browser conversion fallback turned on for this workspace, or the call is rejected.

order_id.description: Your order ID. Required. This is the dedup key: a server-to-server postback for the same integration and order collapses into the same row, and the server-confirmed row always wins.

session_id.description: The player session that produced the sale, if you have it. Used to attribute the conversion and to pick up the session's video if `video_code` is omitted.

video_code.description: Wins over the session's last video when both are available.

properties.description: Extra key/value pairs to keep with the conversion.

BrowserConversionRequest.description: Every row this endpoint writes is stamped `conversion_source: browser` and `verified: false`. It never feeds the revenue, EPC, RPV, or ROAS numbers your dashboard treats as real: those only count `verified` rows. It also never fires ad-platform pixels or CRM webhooks, because an unverified sale must not reach a customer's ad account as a confirmed Purchase event. Use this only as a fallback for a cart that cannot post server-to-server; prefer the real integration postback or `POST /conversions` wherever you can reach either one.

attributed.description: True when `session_id` resolved to a known session.
